The '''''Shadow Raptor''''', originally known as the '''''Eccentric Lad''''', was an [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] and the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] operations in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] and his crew liberated the vessel from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the site of a [[Shadow Raptor revolt|revolt]] by sabotaged [[Droid/Legends|droids]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Shadow Raptor'' forms the setting for most of [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure ''[[Dead in the Water]]''. According to how the players perform, they may save the ship or it may be sucked into a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]].
